OK, to all the people who said we can’t put Stan on the web . . . . what do you think about this??
A

> On Dec 15, 2014, at 1:26 PM, Rob J. Goedman <goe...@icloud.com> wrote:
>
>
> 6. JuliaBox
>
> For those who don’t want to install *any* software, have an account on JuliaBox and access to a browser.
>
> Thanks to Viral, Tanmay and Shashi for installing CmdStan on JuliaBox! JuliaBox gives users a Notebook like interface.
>
> A few example notebooks are included in Stan.jl v”0.2.0” in the Examples/Notebooks subdirectory.
>

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Re: [stan-users] Update on Stan.jl (Stan for Julia users)
parts:
I think it's great! JuliaBox has Amazon as a sponsor, taking care of the cost issue. And the maintenance of servers issue. And the space issue.

I've always thought we could do it. We've been struggling with getting the code factored so it's easy to split off interfaces. Hopefully our next push in development would help us with that. This also goes along with a possible collaboration with Perry + others.



Daniel
